application_periods.label: General
application_periods.notes: Apply through CAO. Late applications (extra CAO fee) may be accepted until 30 November 2026.

aps_rule.notes: Best six subjects excluding Life Orientation; 90-100% = 8 points down to 40-49% = 3. Minimum points per faculty as listed in the CAO handbook.
